summary: The filing is a Form 8-K (Item 8.01) by UBS Commercial Mortgage Trust 2018-C14 and UBS Commercial Mortgage Securitization Corp., reporting a change in special servicer for the Christiana Mall Mortgage Loan, which constitutes 4.6% of the asset pool. Trimont LLC was removed as special servicer, and Green Loan Services LLC was appointed effective July 14, 2026, under the BBCMS 2018-CHRS Trust and Servicing Agreement. No transaction, offer, or strategic change is involved; this is a routine administrative servicing appointment. No deal terms or financial details are disclosed.
